description.narrative: The MOL issued the Agricultural Workers Regulation No. 19 of 2021 which was approved by the Cabinet and published in the national Gazette in May 2021. The Regulation became effective as of 2 May 2021. The regulation provides protection for agricultural workers, including guarantees for safe and decent working conditions and, for the first time ever, authorises labour inspectors to monitor working conditions and OSH in agricultural worlpaces The ILO provided technical guidance and inputs for developing the Regulation and contributed to its dissemination.
